question: Can a training-subject-only temporal filter learned from the full ordered eight-volume event response improve the arm branch beyond the validated mean-window hierarchy?

implementation.filter: pair-specific temporal Fisher direction with covariance shrinkage and second-difference regularization
implementation.outer_protocol: filter learned from source subjects only; saved nested hierarchy configurations reused for the outer evaluation

acceptance_criteria: Extract all 62 ordered event-sequence checkpoints and verify shape/label integrity.
Reconstruct the mean-window hierarchy baseline exactly from sequence means.
Learn every outer-fold temporal filter without held-out-subject labels.
Require repeated balanced and independent improvement with uncertainty before promoting the learned filter.
If neutral or negative, retain mean-window spatial covariance and redirect temporal work away from global linear filters.
